### The King Who Does Not Take
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-27-2023.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 8:11, 13-17
Points:
- Samuel warned the Israelites that human rulers inherently take from their subjects, demanding their labor, resources, and freedom.
- Israel's history confirmed this reality, as successive earthly kings enriched themselves at the people's expense.
- In stark contrast to worldly rulers, Jesus entered the world as a humble King who gives rather than takes.
- Although culture often views following Christ as restrictive, Jesus offers eternal life, rest, and spiritual freedom.
- Jesus never disappoints His people; He gives all that they need and takes away only their sin.
